title: Bantha
caption: Bantha (V)
game_text: May add 2 ‘riders’ (passengers). Ability = 1/2. May move as a ‘react.’ Tusken Raiders here are power +1. Scum And Villainy ignores creature vehicles. During your deploy phase, may ▼ one Bantha Herd.
lore: Transport, pack animal. Many breeds of different sizes and colors. Three meters tall. Can go weeks without food or water. Found throughout the galaxy.

notes: Non-unique (no dot). Icon column empty (only the set symbol); no scomp ring. Curly single quotes around ‘riders’ and ‘react.’ (period inside the closing quote) as printed. The crop cuts the bottom strip: caption read as 'Bantha (V)' from the partially visible strip and the slip title; number 27 from the filename/sheet order. Lore matches the scan. Base scan only at 350 px. Copyright year 1995 (Premiere), not legible. Modern remake is Block-era only (VB1 -pre, 350 px) — used as modern (VB1 URoRRuR'R'R's Bantha and VB3 Bantha Herd are different cards).
